title: Playboy: Karaoke Collection Volume 1
native_title: プレイボーイ・カラオケ ＶＯＬ１
overview: Playboy Karaoke Collection Volume 1 (プレイボーイカラオケVol.1) is a 1996 compilation of karaoke music videos with Playboy models in the background released by VIC Tokai for the Sega Saturn exclusively in Japan. A second volume was also made.
